Name: Small Glade Farm
Author: Teoshen
Description:
Do you want more land to farm on than a postage stamp, but the standard and mega sized farms are too much?
Small Glade Farm is that middle ground. It's a farm big enough to hold all your needs, but not so large that you are overwhelmed with farm chores or feel guilty when Andy makes comments about the free land you inherited. This also puts your farm more in line with but still larger than the other farmers of Stardew Valley Expanded.
While there is enough land to plant a reasonable number of crops, you will have to be judicious in your use of space to make full use of this land.

[b][u]Features:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Gated additional areas. The bridge to the greenhouse area requires a steel axe to clear, and a boulder blocking the lower fields section requires a steel pick. From humble beginnings, this will let your farm expand with your progression.
[*] Enjoy a warm dip from your grandfather's custom-built hot springs in the farm cave.
[*] Mountain fish find their way into the northern stream of the farm, with forest fish available in the farm's southern pond.
[*] Forage for forest mushrooms at your leisure.
[/list]
[b][u]Compatibility:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded!
[*]No known incompatibilities.
[/list]
